epay.text: You must submit the total of all tax withheld for the quarter (after taking credit for monthly and/or weekly payments made), electronically, by 11:59 p.m. on the 30th day of the month following the end of the quarter.

deposits.interpretation: New Jersey files a quarterly return (Form NJ-927) due the 30th of the month after the quarter (April 30, July 30, October 30, January 30), even with no tax. STANDARD employers: if MORE than $500 of New Jersey income tax was collected in the first and/or second month of a quarter, that month is paid with Form NJ-500 by the 15th of the next month (each month is tested on its own); the third month is always paid with the quarterly return, as is any month of $500 or less. WEEKLY payers: an employer with a prior-year liability of $10,000 or more of income tax withheld pays by the Wednesday after the pay week, according to its pay-period frequency (a bi-weekly payroll pays bi-weekly, a monthly payroll monthly); it still files the quarterly return. The booklet's example is a Friday payday (June 7, 2024) paid Wednesday June 12; INTERPRETATION: pay weeks are read as Saturday to Friday, so a Saturday payday falls in the following week, and a week that runs across a quarter end is paid separately for each quarter (the EFT tax-period end date is the quarter's). Household (domestic) employers file and pay once a year with Form NJ-927-H by January 31 (an input, never derived). The prior-year $10,000 test decides weekly versus standard; the look-back amount supplied here is that prior-year liability. Unemployment, disability and family-leave contributions are reported on the same NJ-927 but belong to the Department of Labor and Workforce Development and are not deposited here.

lookback.description: New Jersey income tax withheld in the prior year

returns.name: Form NJ-927 (NJ-927-W for weekly payers), Employer's Quarterly Report
contents: Due the 30th of the month after the quarter, even if no tax was withheld; seasonal businesses file all four quarters.

Reports New Jersey income tax withheld together with unemployment, workforce, family leave and disability wage information (the latter administered by the Department of Labor and Workforce Development).
The total for the quarter, after credit for monthly and weekly payments, is paid electronically with it.

returns.name: Form NJ-500, monthly payment (also used for weekly payments)
contents: Required for the first and second months of a quarter when more than $500 was collected; due the 15th of the following month.
Weekly payers use it for their weekly payments.

returns.name: Form NJ-927-H, household employer annual return
contents: Domestic employers report and pay income tax withholding and unemployment and disability insurance electronically once a year, by January 31 for the prior year; they do not file NJ-927 or NJ-500 unless they also have regular employees.

enrollment: Register as a New Jersey employer online (the guide says an FEIN is required first, and a 10-digit New Jersey Corporate Identification Number for corporate entities).
For ACH debit or credit: register as an ACH payer and use the payment-frequency codes and the quarter-end tax period date (year, month, last day, e.g. 240630).
